cohort: The study included 166 patients with uncomplicated monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies delivered at a single tertiary center.
finding: The risk of neonatal morbidity in uncomplicated monochorionic twins significantly decreases with advanced gestation, with 34 weeks showing higher morbidity compared to 35-37 weeks, and 36 weeks having higher rates of special care unit admission and phototherapy compared to 37 weeks.
